name: high-earner-overrides
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at the end of the plan (terminal wealth), planning to age 90.
- Age 55, married filing jointly, retiring at 65.
- Combined gross income $400,000 a year; can save $60,000 a year.
- Will spend $120,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $900,000 traditional (pre-tax), $200,000 Roth, $500,000 taxable brokerage.
- Employer match: $10,000 a year.
- Social Security: $40,000 a year starting at age 70. Pension: $20,000 a year starting at age 65.
- Catch-up contributions apply: use a $31,000 combined traditional+Roth annual limit.
- Use a 20% capital gains rate. The default expected return is fine.
